author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-08 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: And the strength of man here is the weakness of God.
context_before: Regardless of what man seems to achieve here, the wisdom of this world is foolishness in the eyes of the Lord.
context_after: Yet this world has purpose, for man has to pass through it in order to enter into eternal life.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Awake O Sleeper (1968-01-08).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-08 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Instead, you will become that man.
context_before: I invite you now to go all out and imagine you really are the man or woman you want to be. But do not doubt, for the minute doubt steps in, a mental division descends, as doubt is the devil. If you will believe that regardless of what the world tells you, you are the man you want to be, you won’t go mad.
context_after: Your dream world will rearrange itself to fit your new image into it without any difficulty or help on your part.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Awake O Sleeper (1968-01-08).
